 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, out Caught by Farhan Yousaf!! This is high and it's a good running catch from mid-on. Pakistan are so relieved so see the back of Arjun Rajput. He's been a thorn in their flesh. Wherever you are, whoever you support, take a moment to stand and applaud this young kid. That's exactly what the crowd and the Indian dugout is doing. Rizwanullah seemed to taken pace off for this shortish ball and sucked Arjun into the pull shot early. Arjun wanted to clear the infield off the back foot again, skied that so high off the bottom of the bat. Mid-on ran in and took is near the bowler's stumps. Arjun drags himself off dejected but he's put on a bold show that made the world salute. The lone warrior walks off!  All Highlights Fours Sixes Wicket UDRS 35.2 W Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, out Caught by Farhan Yousaf!! This is high and it's a good running catch from mid-on. Pakistan are so relieved so see the back of Arjun Rajput. He's been a thorn in their flesh. Wherever you are, whoever you support, take a moment to stand and applaud this young kid. That's exactly what the crowd and the Indian dugout is doing. Rizwanullah seemed to taken pace off for this shortish ball and sucked Arjun into the pull shot early. Arjun wanted to clear the infield off the back foot again, skied that so high off the bottom of the bat. Mid-on ran in and took is near the bowler's stumps. Arjun drags himself off dejected but he's put on a bold show that made the world salute. The lone warrior walks off! Arjun Rajput c Farhan Yousaf b Rizwanullah 107(85) [4s-11 6s-5] 35.2 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, wide , short delivery, Arjun sways out. Too high for me says Arjun 35.1 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, shortish delivery, Arjun mistimes the pull to the on-side 34.4 Farhan Yousaf to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, full delivery, Arjun pushes it through cover 34.3 6 Farhan Yousaf to Arjun Rajput, SIX , rocks back and plays a stylish pull. You can watch this guy bat all day. Been such a picture. Quickly rocked back, picked this short ball from outside off stump and whacked it on one leg over mid-wicket, transferring all that weight nicely onto the back foot to generate that power 34.3 Farhan Yousaf to Arjun Rajput, wide , turning away wide of off, called wide 34.2 Farhan Yousaf to Arjun Rajput, no run, quicker delivery, pulled to mid-wicket and it's cut off 32.5 Farhan Yousaf to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, cut away in the gap past point and that's the hundred . Stunning innings, one of the best counterattacking knocks under pressure you will see in cricket . This has to be up in that list for sure. Arjun completes the single, jumps and fist pumps. Takes the helmet off and raises his bat to his teammates and the applause from the crowd. Then extends both his hands and tells that's how it's done out in the middle. Kisses the helmet and raises it as well. His partner congratulates. His fearlessness, clarity in shot-making and understanding where to target has been a treat to watch. Pakistan were so happy chipping away at the wicket but the left-hander has left them scrambling to stop him. Audacious Arjun will surely be on the IPL radar and he's played a stunner with only a month to go for the the IPL Auction 32.4 Farhan Yousaf to Arjun Rajput, no run, full again, pushed to the right of the bowler, who dives to deny the single 32.3 Farhan Yousaf to Arjun Rajput, no run, very full delivery, solid, calming defence 32.2 Farhan Yousaf to Arjun Rajput, 2 runs, cut away past backward point and it's cut off in the deep. Moves to 99 32.1 4 Farhan Yousaf to Arjun Rajput, FOUR , wow! He doesn't care one bit of what's happening at the other end. Rocks back and pulls this flatter delivery over mid-wicket for a stylish four 31.1 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, short of length delivery around the off stump, punched off the back foot to deep point 30.5 Farhan Yousaf to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, quicker delivery on the leg stump, rushed pull to mid-wicket 30.2 Farhan Yousaf to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, shortish and outside off stump, Arjun cuts to deep point 29.6 Mohammad Sayyam to Arjun Rajput, no run, another bumper, this time with more gas, Arjun avoids 29.5 Mohammad Sayyam to Arjun Rajput, no run, short delivery, Arjun sits under it 29.4 Mohammad Sayyam to Arjun Rajput, 2 runs, full and outside off stump, Arjun taps it through cover and they steal the second run as well 29.3 6 Mohammad Sayyam to Arjun Rajput, SIX , but this is a sensation shot! This is some batting from Arjun. Shortish and on the hips, Arjun opens his hips, gets behind the line and whacks it over deep mid-wicket for a deflating six. The ball has gone out of the ground and as the replacement comes, the Pakistani team gets into a huddle 29.2 Mohammad Sayyam to Arjun Rajput, 2 runs, in the airrrr and just over mid-on ! Full and on the stumps, Arjun lofts, mistimes. Fielder runs back and then jumps but it clears him 29.1 Mohammad Sayyam to Arjun Rajput, no run, short of length delivery on the leg stump, clipped to mid-wicket and it's cut off and Arjun is denied a single. These small things could help the bowler as he gets to target the main batter 29.1 Mohammad Sayyam to Arjun Rajput, wide , they are going to test him with the short ball, but Mohammad Sayyam has sprayed this down the leg-side 28.6 Farhan Yousaf to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, fullish delivery, Arjun taps it to cover-point 28.6 Farhan Yousaf to Arjun Rajput, wide , fired down the leg-side 28.5 4 Farhan Yousaf to Arjun Rajput, FOUR , kept feeding it wide of off and Arjun this time manages to slap it in front of square. Hit it to the right of extra-cover and to the left of deep cover and gets the boundary he was looking for in the over 28.3 Farhan Yousaf to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, again short and wide, Arjun cuts to deep point 28.2 Farhan Yousaf to Arjun Rajput, no run, short and turning away wide of off, Arjun mistimes the cut to cover 27.6 6 Mohammad Sayyam to Arjun Rajput, SIX , he only wants to answer with his bat. The bowler tried to bowl a full ball after the bouncer, but Arjun was absolutely ready for it. Not only did he smack this over long-off but hit it so effortlessly. The bowler will definitely not like that kind of confidence from the batter 27.5 Mohammad Sayyam to Arjun Rajput, no run, bouncer, Arjun is beaten on the pull as it came rapidly at him. Mohammad Sayyam extends his followthrough for a long stare but Arjun doesn't even look at the bowler 27.4 Mohammad Sayyam to Arjun Rajput, no run, short delivery, Arjun sits under it 27.2 Mohammad Sayyam to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, full and on the off stump, driven past the diving short cover fielder, mid-off cuts it off to the right 27.1 Mohammad Sayyam to Arjun Rajput, no run, he's been so comfortable against spin so Pakistan have got back their left arm pacer. Short of a length delivery, Arjun defends off the back foot 26.6 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, flatter delivery outside off stump, Arjun tries to dab late, picks out short third man 26.5 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, no run, oh he smashed that drive off the back foot but picked out the man at cover. He is disappointed he didn't place it right. Would have four a couple of yards either side of the fielder 26.2 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, flat-bats the slap off the back foot to long-on, shouts two but doesn't get there 26.2 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, wide , goes for a reverse sweep and misses. Called wide as it was too wide of off 26.1 4 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, FOUR , if you want to fetch the sweep from outside off stump, that's how you do it mate, says Arjun Rajput to Manal Chauhan. Moves across to get closer to the line and belts the sweep. Deep square leg attacks for the catch but it lands in front of him and escapes for four 25.6 Ahmed Hussain to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, full delivery, Arjun taps it to long-off, waits for the ball to pass the bowler and takes the run 25.4 Ahmed Hussain to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, good tight single, tapped this flighted delivery with soft hands to cover-point and set off, got hom tot he other end before the throw arrived 25.3 Ahmed Hussain to Arjun Rajput, no run, full delivery, Arjun pushes it to the bowler who threatens to have a shy but Arjun doesn't bother 25.2 Ahmed Hussain to Arjun Rajput, no run, fullish delivery, Arjun taps it back to the bowler 25.1 4 Ahmed Hussain to Arjun Rajput, FOUR , cut in the air, but it's cut hard and he's found the gap. His mantra is clear. The moment he's allowed to free the arms, he wants to go hard. Cuts to the left of backward point and starts the over on a great note. 100 up for India 24.4 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, moves across and cuts this flatter delivery to deep cover 24.3 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, no run, crashed hard to cover 24.2 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, no run, shortish delivery outside off stump, Arjun mistimes the cut to point 24.1 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, 2 runs, short and wide, Arjun slaps it hard. Deep cover has work to do to his left and he cuts it off. Arjun is seen rushing for the second run, looks like he was slow to take off for the second 23.5 Ahmed Hussain to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, cut square of the wicket for a single 23.4 Ahmed Hussain to Arjun Rajput, FOUR , and now he's forced a leg-side ball and helps himself to a fine sweep for four and raises a brilliant counterattacking fifty . Thumps his chest gently and points the bat to the dressing room where his teammates and coaching staff are seen applauding. Great display of clarity out in the middle from Arjun Rajput 23.3 Ahmed Hussain to Arjun Rajput, no run, pushed to cover 23.2 4 Ahmed Hussain to Arjun Rajput, FOUR , and he cheekily opens the bat face to picking up annoying boundary. Ahmed Hussain bowled the googly, there is a slip but Arjun has put on bold face and guided it past the fielder and even beat short third man easily 23.1 Ahmed Hussain to Arjun Rajput, no run, meanwhile Arjun continues his focus and defends solidly off the front foot 22.3 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, now he cuts fiercely but the man at backward point manages to dive full length and get a hand on it. Great fielding effort 22.2 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, no run, shortish delivery outside off stump, Arjun cuts picks out the man at backward point 22.1 6 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, SIX , he's been such a positive influence out in the middle, in complete contrast to the first 15 odd overs. Shortish delivery, Arjun Rajput moved across, got under it and smashed it over backward square leg 21.6 Ahmed Hussain to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, fullish and just outside off stump, tapped to cover-point 21.5 Ahmed Hussain to Arjun Rajput, no run, flatter delivery just outside off stump, Arjun defends off the back foot 20.6 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, no run, flat good length outside off, Arjun Rajput goes on the back foot and works it to mid-wicket who's on the edge of the ring 20.4 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, tossed up full outside off, Arjun Rajput gets forward to drive to sweeper cover 19.6 Ali Raza to Arjun Rajput, no run, back of a length on middle, pacy delivery, Arjun Rajput with a neat back foot block 19.5 4 Ali Raza to Arjun Rajput, FOUR , just short of third man diving forward. A rising short of length delivery outside off, Arjun Rajput is on his tiptoes as he slashes, third man dives forward and it just fell short of him. He can't stop the four, but a captain anyday will take that effort over saving the boundary 19.4 6 Ali Raza to Arjun Rajput, SIX , superb shot. It's a short of length delivery on off, Arjun Rajput stands tall, gets forward and slams it over wide long-on. Took it on top of the bounce and put it away. Picked the length so well 19.3 Ali Raza to Arjun Rajput, no run, short of length on off and middle, Arjun Rajput goes on the back foot and punches well, but cover dives to his right and cuts it off 19.2 Ali Raza to Arjun Rajput, no run, full on middle, Arjun Rajput gets forward to drive to the right of cover 19.1 Ali Raza to Arjun Rajput, no run, Ali Raza comes back on and beats the bat. From round the wicket, full outside off, no feet from Arjun Rajput as he gets forward to drive big and is beaten 18.5 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, full outside off, Arjun Rajput gets forward and whips the drive wide of the dive of cover to his left 18.4 4 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, FOUR , no deep square leg or deep backward square-leg and that's a safe shot. It's tossed up full outside off, Arjun Rajput gets outside off and low to sweep it there, one bounce over the ropes 18.3 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, no run, tossed up on a good length outside off, Arjun Rajput gets forward and opens the face of the bat to defend to the left of slip who dives and cuts it off 17.6 4 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, FOUR , now Arjun Rajput gets lucky. Full on off, angled in, Rajput with a wild hoick to leg with no feet. He gets lucky as the thick inside edge runs away wide of the stumps to the fine-leg fence 17.5 4 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, FOUR , Arjun Rajput breaks the shackles with a good boundary. Full just outside off, Rajput gets forward and thumps it to the right of Rizwanullah. Was in the air, but sped away 17.4 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, beaten! Full and shapes back into fifth-stump line, then it moves away late to beat the leaden-footed drive of Arjun Rajput. Remember Rizwanullah is bowling from round the wicket 17.1 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, full and wide outside off, Arjun Rajput reaches for it to drive, off the toe-end of the bat and third man is very fine 16.6 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, fired full on middle, Arjun Rajput gets forward to drive to long-on 16.3 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, that's a good shot but just one. On a good length outside off, Arjun Rajput goes on the back foot and opens the face of the bat to dab it wide of backward point who's very square 15.6 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, nearly sneaked through! On a short of length and nips back in to middle, Arjun Rajput is late on the back foot block, the thick inside edge could've gone anywhere, just misses leg-stump 15.2 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, short of length on the body, Arjun Rajput goes on the back foot and pulls to fine-leg. Went fine and the fielder was fine as well 15.1 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, beautiful delivery. Angle in from round the wicket to fifth-stump line, then leaves the left-hander, who pokes and misses 14.6 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, oh he wanted to go over cover but the ball takes the outside edge and flies past point . Full and outside off stump, there for the big drive, Arjun went for it but got deceived in flight 14.5 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, no run, Arjun knocks it to mid-wicket, Aaryavir Sehwag wants a run but sent back and rightly so 14.4 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, no run, plays inside the line and misses this flighted delivery 14.3 Niqab Shafiq to Arjun Rajput, no run, shortish delivery, Arjun taps it off the back foot to cover 13.6 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, oh yeah, there's the bumper as expected. Fast bowlers don't miss these cues. Arjun this time sits easily under it though 13.5 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, oh he's given signs of not playing the short ball well and the Pakistanis will take note. Short delivery, Arjun was late on the shot and he spliced this to mid-on. Arjun Rajput has looked solid otherwise 13.3 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, fullish delivery on the leg stump, Arjun clips it to deep square leg 13.2 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, again nicely gets behind the line and defends with soft hands to cover-point, thinks of a quick single and kills that idea himself 13.1 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, fullish delivery on the off stump, Arjun gets right behing the line and defends 12.5 Hasnain Abbas Dar to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, fullish delivery, Arjun taps it to cover-point for a quick single. Fielder realized he had to quickly release the ball to have a chance for a runout so he dived forward and underarmed without power 12.4 4 Hasnain Abbas Dar to Arjun Rajput, FOUR , lovely drive down the ground and that should ease some nerves for Arjun Rajput. Full and in the slot, let this ball come to him and gave it the full face of the bat. This is only the second boundary of the innings 12.3 Hasnain Abbas Dar to Arjun Rajput, no run, good length delivery from round the wicket, Arjun defends 11.6 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, beaten . Short of a length delivery, plays inside the line and misses 11.5 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, fullish delivery outside off stump, left alone LATEST NEWS
